mapper.select: select detail_id, transfer_id, item_type, item_id, product_id, quantity, delivered_quantity, received_quantity from inv_transfer_detail where transfer_id = #{transferId} order by detail_id for update

select shipment_detail_id, shipment_id, transfer_id, transfer_detail_id, item_type, item_id, product_id, shipped_quantity, received_quantity from inv_transfer_shipment_detail where shipment_id = #{shipmentId} order by shipment_detail_id for update

select allocation_id, shipment_id, shipment_detail_id, transfer_id, transfer_detail_id, balance_id, lot_id, location_id, allocation_policy, tracking_policy, allocated_quantity, balance_version_after, cost_price, total_cost, accepted_received_quantity, damaged_received_quantity, shortage_reported_quantity, receipt_version from inv_transfer_shipment_allocation where shipment_id = #{shipmentId} order by allocation_id for update

select warehouse_id, write_mode, read_mode, reconcile_status, last_reconcile_time, last_reconcile_batch, approved_by, approved_time from inv_warehouse_stock_mode where warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} for update

select policy_id, item_type, item_id, allocation_policy, tracking_policy, status, version from inv_item_fulfillment_policy where
(item_type = #{item.itemType} and item_id = #{item.itemId})
order by item_type, item_id for update

select stock_id, item_type, item_id, product_id, shop_dept_id, warehouse_id, current_quantity, locked_quantity, available_quantity, quarantine_quantity, cost_price, total_cost, version from inv_stock where shop_dept_id = #{shopDeptId} and warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} and
(item_type = #{item.itemType} and item_id = #{item.itemId})
order by stock_id for update

select balance_id, item_type, item_id, product_id, warehouse_id, lot_id, location_id, current_quantity, locked_quantity, available_quantity, quarantine_quantity, cost_price, total_cost, version from inv_stock_balance_detail where warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} and
(lot_id = #{item.lotId} and location_id = #{item.locationId})
order by balance_id for update

select audit.shipment_serial_id, audit.allocation_id, audit.shipment_id, audit.serial_id, audit.serial_no_snapshot, serial_current.serial_no as current_serial_no, audit.item_type, audit.item_id, audit.source_balance_id, audit.source_lot_id, audit.source_location_id, audit.status_after, serial_current.warehouse_id as current_warehouse_id, serial_current.balance_id as current_balance_id, serial_current.lot_id as current_lot_id, serial_current.location_id as current_location_id, serial_current.serial_status as current_status from inv_transfer_shipment_serial audit inner join inv_inventory_serial serial_current on serial_current.serial_id = audit.serial_id and serial_current.item_type = audit.item_type and serial_current.item_id = audit.item_id left join inv_transfer_shipment_receipt_serial receipt_serial on receipt_serial.shipment_id = audit.shipment_id and receipt_serial.shipment_serial_id = audit.shipment_serial_id where audit.shipment_id = #{shipmentId} and receipt_serial.receipt_serial_id is null order by serial_current.serial_id for update
mapper.insert: insert into inv_transfer_shipment_receipt ( shipment_id, transfer_id, receipt_no, command_request_id, request_fingerprint, receipt_plan_version, source_shipment_plan_version, source_reconcile_batch, target_warehouse_id, target_reconcile_batch, arrived_time, finalize_shipment, accepted_quantity, damaged_quantity, shortage_quantity, remaining_quantity_after, receipt_status, operator_user_id, operator_name, create_by, create_time, remark ) values ( #{receipt.shipmentId}, #{receipt.transferId}, #{receipt.receiptNo}, #{receipt.commandRequestId}, #{receipt.requestFingerprint}, #{receipt.receiptPlanVersion}, #{receipt.sourceShipmentPlanVersion}, #{receipt.sourceReconcileBatch}, #{receipt.targetWarehouseId}, #{receipt.targetReconcileBatch}, #{receipt.arrivedTime}, case when #{receipt.finalizeShipment} then '1' else '0' end, #{receipt.acceptedQuantity}, #{receipt.damagedQuantity}, #{receipt.shortageQuantity}, #{receipt.remainingQuantityAfter}, #{receipt.receiptStatus}, #{receipt.operatorUserId}, #{receipt.operatorName}, #{receipt.createBy}, #{receipt.createdTime}, #{receipt.remark} )

insert into inv_stock ( item_type, item_id, product_id, shop_dept_id, warehouse_id, current_quantity, locked_quantity, available_quantity, quarantine_quantity, cost_price, total_cost, version, last_in_time, create_by, create_time, remark ) select #{stock.itemKey.itemType}, #{stock.itemKey.itemId}, #{stock.productId}, #{warehouseId}, #{warehouseId}, #{stock.acceptedQuantity} + #{stock.damagedQuantity}, 0, #{stock.acceptedQuantity}, #{stock.damagedQuantity}, #{stock.incomingCost} / nullif( #{stock.acceptedQuantity} + #{stock.damagedQuantity}, 0), #{stock.incomingCost}, 0, sysdate(), #{createBy}, sysdate(), 'V2 transfer receipt target summary' where #{warehouseId} > 0 and #{stock.acceptedQuantity} >= 0 and #{stock.damagedQuantity} >= 0 and (#{stock.acceptedQuantity} + #{stock.damagedQuantity}) > 0 and #{stock.incomingCost} >= 0 and #{stock.currentQuantityBefore} = 0 and #{stock.currentQuantityAfter} = #{stock.acceptedQuantity} + #{stock.damagedQuantity}

insert into inv_inventory_lot ( lot_no, item_type, item_id, product_id, warehouse_id, supplier_batch_no, production_date, expiry_date, qc_status, lot_status, source_type, source_business_id, source_lot_id, receipt_disposition, create_by, create_time, remark ) select #{lot.lotNo}, #{lot.key.itemType}, #{lot.key.itemId}, #{lot.productId}, #{lot.key.warehouseId}, #{lot.supplierBatchNo}, #{lot.productionDate}, #{lot.expiryDate}, #{lot.qcStatus}, #{lot.lotStatus}, 'transfer', #{transferId}, #{lot.key.sourceLotId}, #{lot.key.disposition}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), 'V2 transfer receipt derived lot' where #{lot.key.warehouseId} > 0 and #{lot.key.sourceLotId} > 0 and #{lot.key.disposition} in ('accepted', 'damaged')

insert into inv_stock_balance_detail ( item_type, item_id, product_id, warehouse_id, lot_id, location_id, current_quantity, locked_quantity, available_quantity, quarantine_quantity, cost_price, total_cost, version, last_in_time, create_by, create_time, remark ) select #{balance.key.lotKey.itemType}, #{balance.key.lotKey.itemId}, #{productId}, #{warehouseId}, #{targetLotId}, #{balance.key.locationId}, #{balance.availableQuantity} + #{balance.quarantineQuantity}, 0, #{balance.availableQuantity}, #{balance.quarantineQuantity}, #{balance.incomingCost} / nullif( #{balance.availableQuantity} + #{balance.quarantineQuantity}, 0), #{balance.incomingCost}, 0, sysdate(), #{createBy}, sysdate(), 'V2 transfer receipt target balance' where #{warehouseId} = #{balance.key.lotKey.warehouseId} and #{targetLotId} > 0 and #{balance.key.locationId} > 0 and #{balance.availableQuantity} >= 0 and #{balance.quarantineQuantity} >= 0 and (#{balance.availableQuantity} + #{balance.quarantineQuantity}) > 0 and #{balance.incomingCost} >= 0 and #{balance.currentQuantityBefore} = 0 and #{balance.currentQuantityAfter} = #{balance.availableQuantity} + #{balance.quarantineQuantity}

insert into inv_stock_log ( item_type, item_id, product_id, shop_dept_id, warehouse_id, movement_type, business_type, business_id, business_no, change_quantity, before_quantity, after_quantity, cost_price, create_by, create_time, remark ) values ( #{stockLog.itemKey.itemType}, #{stockLog.itemKey.itemId}, #{stockLog.productId}, #{receipt.targetWarehouseId}, #{receipt.targetWarehouseId}, 'transfer_in', 'transfer_receipt', #{receipt.transferId}, #{receipt.receiptNo}, #{stockLog.changeQuantity}, #{stockLog.beforeQuantity}, #{stockLog.afterQuantity}, #{stockLog.costPrice}, #{receipt.createBy}, sysdate(), concat('accepted=', #{stockLog.acceptedQuantity}, ', damaged=', #{stockLog.damagedQuantity}) )

insert into inv_transfer_shipment_receipt_allocation ( receipt_id, shipment_id, shipment_allocation_id, shipment_detail_id, transfer_detail_id, item_type, item_id, product_id, tracking_policy, source_balance_id, source_lot_id, source_location_id, cost_price, accepted_quantity, damaged_quantity, shortage_quantity, accepted_cost, damaged_cost, allocation_version_before, allocation_version_after, accepted_location_id, accepted_target_lot_id, accepted_target_balance_id, accepted_balance_version_before, accepted_balance_version_after, quarantine_location_id, damaged_target_lot_id, damaged_target_balance_id, damaged_balance_version_before, damaged_balance_version_after, discrepancy_note, attachment_refs, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{receiptId}, #{shipmentId}, #{allocation.shipmentAllocationId}, #{allocation.shipmentDetailId}, #{allocation.transferDetailId}, #{allocation.itemKey.itemType}, #{allocation.itemKey.itemId}, #{allocation.productId}, #{allocation.trackingPolicy}, #{allocation.sourceBalanceId}, #{allocation.sourceLotId}, #{allocation.sourceLocationId}, #{allocation.sourceCostPrice}, #{allocation.acceptedQuantity}, #{allocation.damagedQuantity}, #{allocation.shortageQuantity}, #{allocation.acceptedCost}, #{allocation.damagedCost}, #{allocation.expectedReceiptVersion}, #{allocation.expectedReceiptVersion} + 1, #{allocation.acceptedLocationId}, #{acceptedTargetLotId}, #{acceptedTargetBalanceId}, #{allocation.acceptedBalanceVersionBefore}, #{allocation.acceptedBalanceVersionAfter}, #{allocation.quarantineLocationId}, #{damagedTargetLotId}, #{damagedTargetBalanceId}, #{allocation.damagedBalanceVersionBefore}, #{allocation.damagedBalanceVersionAfter}, #{allocation.discrepancyNote}, #{allocation.attachmentRefs}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )

insert into inv_transfer_receipt_discrepancy_case ( receipt_id, receipt_allocation_id, shipment_id, transfer_id, shipment_allocation_id, discrepancy_type, discrepancy_quantity, source_cost_price, discrepancy_amount, fact_fingerprint, discrepancy_note, attachment_refs, status, case_version, create_by, create_time ) select #{receiptId}, #{receiptAllocationId}, #{receipt.shipmentId}, #{receipt.transferId}, #{discrepancy.shipmentAllocationId}, #{discrepancy.discrepancyType}, #{discrepancy.discrepancyQuantity}, #{discrepancy.sourceCostPrice}, #{discrepancy.discrepancyAmount}, #{discrepancy.factFingerprint}, ra.discrepancy_note, ra.attachment_refs, 'awaiting_confirmation', 0, #{receipt.createBy}, #{receipt.createdTime} from inv_transfer_shipment_receipt_allocation ra where ra.receipt_allocation_id = #{receiptAllocationId} and ra.receipt_id = #{receiptId} and ra.shipment_id = #{receipt.shipmentId} and ra.shipment_allocation_id = #{discrepancy.shipmentAllocationId} and #{receipt.transferId} > 0 and #{discrepancy.discrepancyType} in ('damaged', 'shortage') and #{discrepancy.discrepancyQuantity} > 0 and #{discrepancy.discrepancyQuantity} = case when #{discrepancy.discrepancyType} = 'damaged' then ra.damaged_quantity else ra.shortage_quantity end and #{discrepancy.sourceCostPrice} = ra.cost_price and #{discrepancy.sourceCostPrice} >= 0 and #{discrepancy.discrepancyAmount} = round( ra.cost_price * #{discrepancy.discrepancyQuantity}, 6) and #{discrepancy.discrepancyAmount} >= 0 and length(#{discrepancy.factFingerprint}) = 64 and #{discrepancy.factFingerprint} not regexp '[^a-f0-9]' and ra.discrepancy_note = #{discrepancy.discrepancyNote} and length(trim(ra.discrepancy_note)) between 1 and 500 and ra.attachment_refs = #{discrepancy.attachmentRefs} and length(trim(ra.attachment_refs)) between 1 and 2000

insert into inv_transfer_shipment_receipt_serial ( receipt_id, receipt_allocation_id, shipment_id, shipment_allocation_id, shipment_serial_id, serial_id, serial_no_snapshot, disposition, source_balance_id, source_lot_id, source_location_id, target_balance_id, target_lot_id, target_location_id, status_before, status_after, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{receiptId}, #{receiptAllocationId}, #{shipmentId}, #{serial.shipmentAllocationId}, #{serial.shipmentSerialId}, #{serial.serialId}, #{serial.serialNo}, #{serial.disposition}, #{serial.sourceBalanceId}, #{serial.sourceLotId}, #{serial.sourceLocationId}, #{targetBalanceId}, #{targetLotId}, #{serial.targetLocationId}, #{serial.statusBefore}, #{serial.statusAfter}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )

insert into inv_stock_ledger_detail ( request_id, command_request_id, receipt_allocation_id, receipt_disposition, summary_stock_log_id, warehouse_id, item_type, item_id, product_id, movement_type, business_type, business_id, business_no, to_balance_id, to_lot_id, to_location_id, change_quantity, before_quantity, after_quantity, cost_price, total_cost, operator_user_id, operator_name, occurred_time, create_by, create_time, remark ) values ( #{ledger.requestId}, #{receipt.commandRequestId}, #{receiptAllocationId}, #{ledger.disposition}, #{summaryStockLogId}, #{receipt.targetWarehouseId}, #{ledger.itemKey.itemType}, #{ledger.itemKey.itemId}, #{ledger.productId}, 'transfer_in', 'transfer_receipt', #{receiptId}, #{receipt.receiptNo}, #{targetBalanceId}, #{targetLotId}, #{ledger.targetBalanceKey.locationId}, #{ledger.changeQuantity}, #{ledger.beforeQuantity}, #{ledger.afterQuantity}, #{ledger.costPrice}, #{ledger.totalCost}, #{receipt.operatorUserId}, #{receipt.operatorName}, #{receipt.arrivedTime}, #{receipt.createBy}, sysdate(), concat('V2 transfer receipt ', #{ledger.disposition}) )
mapper.update: update inv_transfer_shipment_allocation set accepted_received_quantity = accepted_received_quantity + #{acceptedDelta}, damaged_received_quantity = damaged_received_quantity + #{damagedDelta}, shortage_reported_quantity = shortage_reported_quantity + #{shortageDelta}, receipt_version = receipt_version + 1 where allocation_id = #{allocationId} and shipment_id = #{shipmentId} and receipt_version = #{receiptVersion} and #{acceptedDelta} >= 0 and #{damagedDelta} >= 0 and #{shortageDelta} >= 0 and (#{acceptedDelta} + #{damagedDelta} + #{shortageDelta}) > 0 and accepted_received_quantity >= 0 and damaged_received_quantity >= 0 and shortage_reported_quantity >= 0 and accepted_received_quantity + damaged_received_quantity + shortage_reported_quantity + #{acceptedDelta} + #{damagedDelta} + #{shortageDelta} <= allocated_quantity

update inv_stock set cost_price = (coalesce(total_cost, 0) + #{incomingCost}) / (current_quantity + #{acceptedQuantity} + #{damagedQuantity}), current_quantity = current_quantity + #{acceptedQuantity} + #{damagedQuantity}, available_quantity = available_quantity + #{acceptedQuantity}, quarantine_quantity = quarantine_quantity + #{damagedQuantity}, total_cost = coalesce(total_cost, 0) + #{incomingCost}, last_in_time = sysdate(), version = version + 1, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where stock_id = #{stockId} and shop_dept_id = #{shopDeptId} and warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} and version = #{version} and #{acceptedQuantity} >= 0 and #{damagedQuantity} >= 0 and (#{acceptedQuantity} + #{damagedQuantity}) > 0 and #{incomingCost} >= 0 and current_quantity >= 0 and available_quantity >= 0 and locked_quantity >= 0 and quarantine_quantity >= 0 and coalesce(total_cost, 0) >= 0 and current_quantity = available_quantity + locked_quantity + quarantine_quantity

update inv_stock_balance_detail set cost_price = (coalesce(total_cost, 0) + #{incomingCost}) / (current_quantity + #{availableQuantity} + #{quarantineQuantity}), current_quantity = current_quantity + #{availableQuantity} + #{quarantineQuantity}, available_quantity = available_quantity + #{availableQuantity}, quarantine_quantity = quarantine_quantity + #{quarantineQuantity}, total_cost = coalesce(total_cost, 0) + #{incomingCost}, last_in_time = sysdate(), version = version + 1, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where balance_id = #{balanceId} and warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} and lot_id = #{lotId} and location_id = #{locationId} and version = #{version} and #{availableQuantity} >= 0 and #{quarantineQuantity} >= 0 and (#{availableQuantity} + #{quarantineQuantity}) > 0 and #{incomingCost} >= 0 and current_quantity >= 0 and available_quantity >= 0 and locked_quantity >= 0 and quarantine_quantity >= 0 and coalesce(total_cost, 0) >= 0 and current_quantity = available_quantity + locked_quantity + quarantine_quantity

update inv_inventory_serial set warehouse_id = #{targetWarehouseId}, balance_id = #{targetBalanceId}, lot_id = #{targetLotId}, location_id = #{targetLocationId}, serial_status = #{statusAfter}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where serial_id = #{serialId} and warehouse_id = #{sourceWarehouseId} and balance_id = #{sourceBalanceId} and lot_id = #{sourceLotId} and location_id = #{sourceLocationId} and serial_status = 'shipped' and #{targetWarehouseId} > 0 and #{targetBalanceId} > 0 and #{targetLotId} > 0 and #{targetLocationId} > 0 and #{statusAfter} in ('available', 'quarantine')

update inv_transfer_order set status = #{statusAfter}, received_time = #{receivedTime}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate(), version = version + 1 where transfer_id = #{transferId} and status = #{expectedStatus} and version = #{expectedVersion} and #{expectedStatus} in ('partial_delivered', 'delivered', 'partial_received') and #{statusAfter} in ('partial_received', 'received', 'discrepancy')
mapper.insert: insert into inv_transfer_status_log ( transfer_id, from_status, to_status, action, operator_id, operator_name, reason, create_time ) values ( #{transferId}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{action}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, #{reason}, sysdate() )
